reasoning_content: ServerBootstrap imports WorldTick directly! I need to remove that import too.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Comment out WorldTick import
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's|import { WorldTick }|// import { WorldTick }|' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/ServerBootstrap.ts")
print("Commented:", stdout.read().decode())

# Also check for any WorldTick references in the file
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'WorldTick' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/ServerBootstrap.ts | head -5")
print("\nRefs:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
